directOffers.note: Contract-free direct payment at E-Werk Mittelbaden Type 2 charging points. The official page publishes no AC blocking fee, so none is modeled.

Contract-free direct payment at E-Werk Mittelbaden CCS charging points. The official blocking fee is 0.18 EUR per additional minute after a standing time of more than two hours; no fee cap is published.

paymentAuthorization.reason: The payment provider reserves up to 95.20 EUR before the session and releases the unused balance. This is a temporary card authorization, not a tariff component or session-price cap.

roamingDeferred.reason: The official FAQ states that the user's roaming-provider contract terms apply when a roaming card or app is used. Keep those eMSP terms separate and never attach this direct ad-hoc tariff to third-party physical CPO sites.

networkEvidence.policy: Attach both ad-hoc offers only to physical E-Werk Mittelbaden sites. Re-audit if a site outside Baden-Württemberg appears.

deferred.acBlockingFee: The current official page publishes no AC blocking fee. No such fee is fabricated.
deferred.dcBlockingFeeCap: The current official page publishes no DC blocking-fee cap. No cap is inferred from the 95.20 EUR payment authorization.

note: Current official public-network tariff checked 2026-09-01. Direct QR payment without registration costs 0.476 EUR/kWh on Type 2 AC and 0.65 EUR/kWh on CCS DC. PayPal, Visa and Mastercard are supported. Only the operator's own physical CPO scope is attached here.
